attchmntText: MV Electrosystems Limited has informed the Exchange about Link of Recording
voiceSummary: MV Electrosystems Limited has uploaded the audio recording of the conference call for investors and analysts regarding the Q2 FY26-27 results. The call was held virtually on Wednesday, November 18, 2026, at 11:00 a.m. IST. The recording is available on the Company’s website at https://mvelectrosystems.com/investor-documents.php?category=investor-call-recordings. This information is also being uploaded to the Company’s website at www.mvelectrosystems.com. The filing is made pursuant to Regulation 30 read with Part A of Schedule III of the SEBI (Listing Obligations and Disclosure Requirements) Regulations, 2015. The Company Secretary and Compliance Officer, Sourabh Bansal, signed the communication on behalf of MV Electrosystems Limited.

attchmntText: MV Electrosystems Limited has informed the Exchange about Copy of Newspaper Publication
voiceSummary: MV Electrosystems Limited has published a notice of postal ballot in the Financial Express and Janasatta newspapers on November 18, 2026. The company has also uploaded the notice and related information on its website at www.mvelectrosystems.com. This filing is made pursuant to the SEBI LODR Regulations, 2015. The notice is placed before members for approval via postal ballot. The specific resolutions subject to this vote are not detailed in this announcement. Shareholders are requested to participate in the postal ballot process. The results of the postal ballot are awaited pending the scrutiny of votes.

attchmntText: MV Electrosystems Limited has informed the Exchange regarding Notice of Postal Ballot
voiceSummary: MV Electrosystems Limited has issued a Postal Ballot Notice to seek shareholder approval for a special resolution regarding the revision in remuneration of Managing Director Mr. Pankaj Rastogi, DIN 11307172. The resolution is effective from October 01, 2026, for the remaining tenure. The cut-off date for eligibility is November 13, 2026. Remote e-voting is open from November 18, 2026, at 10:00 AM to December 17, 2026, at 05:00 PM. Taruna Kalra & Associates has been appointed as the Scrutinizer. Voting results are awaited and will be announced within two working days after the e-voting period concludes. The resolution is subject to shareholder approval.

attchmntText: MV Electrosystems Limited has informed the Exchange about Investor Presentation
voiceSummary: MV Electrosystems Limited submitted an investor presentation regarding its unaudited financial results for the quarter and half year ended September 30, 2026. The presentation is available on the company website at www.mvelectrosystems.com. For the half year ended September 30, 2026, the company reported net revenue from operations of Rs 31.7 Cr, compared to Rs 25.9 Cr in the same period last year. The reported profit after tax was a loss of Rs 12.1 Cr, with a diluted earnings per share of minus Rs 5.4. The company highlighted an executable order book for 3-Phase Propulsion Equipment valued at Rs 975.6 Cr, including annual maintenance contract value. The company also noted that it manufactured, billed, and dispatched seven propulsion systems in September 2026.

attchmntText: MV Electrosystems Limited has informed the Exchange about Bagging/Receiving of orders/contracts
voiceSummary: MV Electrosystems Limited received a letter of acceptance from Chiranjan Locomotive Works for an order valued at Rs. 325.26 Crore including GST. The contract involves the supply of 156 sets of IGBT-based 3-phase drive propulsion equipment for WAG9, WAG9H, WAP7, and WAP5 electric locomotives. Deliveries are scheduled between April 2027 and January 2028. The agreement also includes comprehensive annual maintenance for three years. The entity awarding the order is domestic. There is no interest held by the promoter group in the awarding entity. The transaction is not a related party transaction. This information is filed pursuant to Regulation 30 of SEBI Listing Regulations 2015.

attchmntText: MV Electrosystems Limited has informed the Exchange about Schedule of meet
voiceSummary: MV Electrosystems Limited has announced an Investors and Analysts Conference Call to discuss the Unaudited financial results for the Quarter and Half year ended September 30, 2026. The call is scheduled for Wednesday, November 18, 2026, at 11:00 AM IST. Management representatives including Mr. Mohit Vohra, Mr. Pankaj Rastogi, and Mr. Ajay Kumar will participate. Dial-in numbers are provided for domestic and international access. Contact details for Stellar IR are also included for further information. This disclosure is made pursuant to Regulation 30 of the SEBI LODR Regulations 2015.

attchmntText: MV Electrosystems Limited has informed the Exchange about Copy of Newspaper Publication
voiceSummary: MV Electrosystems Limited filed a notice with the National Stock Exchange and BSE Limited regarding the newspaper publication of its Unaudited Standalone and Consolidated Financial Results for the quarter and half year ended September 30, 2026. The publication appeared in Financial Express in all English editions and Jansatta in Hindi on September 13, 2026. The documents include a Quick Response code and a link to access the results on the company website at www.mvelectrosystems.com. The Company Secretary and Compliance Officer, Sourabh Bansal, submitted this information for the exchanges' records.

MV Electrosystems Limited filed the Monitoring Agency Report issued by CARE Ratings Limited for the quarter and half year ended September 30, 2026. The report confirms that all proceeds from the Initial Public Offering, aggregating to Rs. 290.00 crore, were utilized as per the objectives mentioned in the offer document during Q2FY27. There were no deviations from the objects of the issue. The monitoring agency noted that bank statements from Indian Overseas Bank showed consolidated entries for daily transactions, preventing direct ascertainment of individual payees. Consequently, CARE Ratings relied on management and Chartered Accountant certificates for verification. The company spent Rs. 0.09 crore towards research and development from a cash credit account and reimbursed Rs. 7.75 crore for issue-related expenses incurred prior to receiving IPO proceeds. All statutory approvals and technical assistance arrangements are reported as obtained and operational.

attchmntText: MV Electrosystems Limited has informed the Exchange about statement of deviation(s) or variation(s) under Reg. 32
desc: Statement of deviation(s) or variation(s) under Reg. 32
voiceSummary: MV Electrosystems Limited has filed a statement with the National Stock Exchange and BSE Limited regarding the utilization of funds raised through its Initial Public Offer. The filing covers the quarter and half year ended September 30, 2026. The company confirms that there is no deviation or variation in the utilization of these proceeds for the specified period. This disclosure is made pursuant to Regulation 32 of the SEBI Listing Obligations and Disclosure Requirements Regulations, 2015. The statement was signed by Sourabh Bansal, the Company Secretary and Compliance Officer. The exchange is requested to take the statement on record.

attchmntText: MV Electrosystems Limited has informed the Exchange about Clarification
voiceSummary: MV Electrosystems Limited has issued a clarification regarding its uploaded financial results. The amounts mentioned on Page 7 under Point C in the Notes to Financial Statements are in Crores and not in Millions. The company requests the National Stock Exchange of India Limited and BSE Limited to take this correction on record.

attchmntText: MV Electrosystems Limited has submitted to the Exchange, the financial results for the period ended September 30, 2026.
voiceSummary: MV Electrosystems Limited announced the outcome of its Board of Directors meeting held on November 12, 2026. The Board approved the unaudited financial results for the quarter and half-year ended September 30, 2026. The results were reviewed by the Audit Committee and subsequently approved by the Board. The company submitted the Limited Review Report by Statutory Auditors M/s. Sanmarks & Associates, Chartered Accountants, along with the unaudited financial results, statement of assets and liability, cash flow statement, and related party transactions. The Board meeting commenced at 01:00 P.M. IST and concluded at 4:00 P.M. IST. The information is available on the company website at www.mvelectrosystems.com.
